verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official CLI (sentry-cli) primarily for debug files, release/source-map management (sentry-docs-7/24, sentry-probe-4), and separately an AI-focused installer (`npx @sentry/ai install`) that configures Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok to use Sentry via MCP (sentry-docs-1, sentry-docs-19). This shows an official CLI touchpoint for AI-native workflows, but it's mainly a bootstrap/installer for MCP rather than a full agentic CLI in its own right. Missing for 10: evidence of the CLI itself exposing rich agentic commands (query issues, trigger autofix, etc.) beyond installation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of its AI-native usage.
